NEXT How to watch Detroit Tigers games in 2026: New broadcast details released DETROIT – The Detroit Tigers have announced TV channels for their games during the 2026 season.Almost exactly 24 hours before the Tigers are set to begin the regular season against the Padres in San Diego, sideline reporter Daniella Bruce released information about the distribution agreements for the new Detroit SportsNet.Comcast/Xfinity customers can watch the Tigers on channel 1253.DirecTV customers can watch on channel 663-3 or DirecTV stream 663.U-verse customers can watch on Channel 1739.Charter/Spectrum customers will be able to watch on the following channels, depending on location:Channel 213 -- Alpena, Detroit, Duluth-Superior, Flint-Saginaw, Grand Rapids-Kalamazoo, Lansing, Marquette, Traverse CityChannel 291 -- LivoniaChannel 307/1307 -- Ft. Wayne, Green Bay-Appleton, ToledoChannel 436 -- if you’re watching on the Spectrum AppBruce posted that more information about additional providers is coming Thursday morning. First pitch against the Padres is scheduled for 4:10 p.m. Thursday.--> Detroit Tigers preview 2026 season with new uniforms, food, and premium seatingCopyright 2026 by WDIV ClickOnDetroit - All rights reserved.About the AuthorDerick Hutchinson headshotDerick HutchinsonDerick is the Digital Executive Producer for ClickOnDetroit and has been with Local 4 News since April 2013.
